sources.title: The Local Bubble Is a Magnetized, Multi-temperature Superbubble: 3D Dust Shell Model (A_G = 0.5 mag/kpc threshold)
sources.credit: O'Neill, T. J., Zucker, C., Goodman, A. A., & Edenhofer, G. (2024, ApJ 973, 136); Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/INB1RB
sources.citation: O'Neill, T. J., Zucker, C., Goodman, A. A., & Edenhofer, G. 2024, ApJ, 973, 136 (doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ad47b5)
sources.note: Derived from ONeill2024_LocalBubble_ShellProperties_A0.5.fits (786,432 HEALPix nside=256 directions derived from the Edenhofer et al. 2024 3D dust map). Aggregated onto a closed nside=48 HEALPix 2-manifold (27,648 vertices, 55,292 outward triangles) in heliocentric Galactic Cartesian coordinates scaled to 1 unit = 100 pc.
